slides.copy_text: Hi Riya, I'm Aarav, a 2nd-year CSE student. I built Bus Timings (bus-timings.vercel.app), a web app that shows live college bus times, using React and Node. I saw Pixelkart is building a student marketplace. Could I help as an intern this summer? I'm happy to do a small test task first. Thanks, Aarav
